dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.ui.typebinding.geterasure>
<!description: Use ITypeBinding.getErasure().getTypeDeclaration() to get the raw type declaration, avoiding issues with captures and type variables, as per JDT internal fix.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: jdt-api, generics-fix>

$binding.getTypeDeclaration()
=>
$binding.getErasure().getTypeDeclaration()
;;
summary: Replace ITypeBinding.getTypeDeclaration() with ITypeBinding.getErasure().getTypeDeclaration() to correctly resolve type declarations when dealing with generic type captures or variables.
